text.content:
The ring of towers where the crater was.

Region: City Center (district A). Was: the Hot Zone: old City Center, Corp Center, Bank Block, Med Center
Controlled by: Each tower's own security; the NCPD's best-funded patrol, paid by the towers' "district improvement levy"
The feel of it: Glass, cameras on every corner, and a memorial facing an Arasaka construction site
Notable locations: Memorial Park, the Arasaka Tower Site, The View (#23), Reconciliation Park, Kang Tao Tower, Biotechnica Spire
Danger: Corporate. SC 9 (NCPD and tower security, Hardened Heavy). UC 2

Since the 2052 cleanup this has been the ring-and-spoke showcase of the new Night City: two ring roads around Memorial Park, eight avenues running out like spokes, and a megacorp tower on every lot of the ring, including Biotechnica, Kang Tao, Petrochem, Zetatech, Night Corp's second tower and a dozen banks. South of the park is Reconciliation Park and its lake of real water. East of it, on the last empty lot, is the Arasaka Tower Site.

Almost nobody lives here: it's offices, hotels, the luxury mall The View and the penthouses of people who own other homes.

Recent History

  • 2052: The crater is cleared, and the Council auctions the ring lots.
  • 2061: Kang Tao takes the last lot on the inner ring.
  • 2070: Under the Accord, Arasaka gets the deed to the last lot on the outer ring, where the old tower stood.

Places

  • Memorial Park. SC 9. Black glass, a ring of names, a garden where the crater was deepest. Static Night vigils start here.
  • The View (#23). SC 9. Luxury mall on the ring road: Jinguji's flagship, Kiroshi's optics salon, a restaurant serving real beef.
  • Reconciliation Park. SC 8. Corpo kids rent paddle boats; joggers run in armored gear.
  • Kang Tao Tower. SC 10. A lobby showroom of smart weapons you need a corporate license to touch.
  • Biotechnica Spire. SC 10. Green glass and vertical gardens; real fruit in the atrium at forty eddies a peach.

Getting There

NCART: Corporate Plaza (Central Loop, Star Line); Business Connect planned.

Turf

None. Draw a gun here and find out.

People

  • Inspector Dana Whitlow (Solo 6, NCPD). Commands the Plaza patrol, and keeps the street people out.
  • Hiro Takemura-Bell (Exec 7, Arasaka). Site director for the new tower.
  • Old Nan (Medtech 2). Runs a noodle cart by the memorial, and knows which of the names are spelled wrong.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.07
